body: DEFERRED — revisit after the current sync/EO work closes; no action now and no new gates. Source: independent read-only Fable::Consultant (session-18147), 2026-11-15, based on Orca docs (orchestration, agents/sessions, mobile). Orca is UI-first and weaker on evidence/completion authority; our WorkRun/fences, submissionAttempt/resultId, fan-in and READY manifest are already stronger. Worth revisiting, in priority order: (1) host-computed cross-host 'Needs Greg' from actual approvals, held delegations, provider limits, unaccepted handoffs and open Greg decisions, surfaced through existing Telegram; this is a view, not watcher/gate, and Telegram authority for commit/push needs a ruling before reliance; (2) operator-reserved decisions as required-child items with question/options and Greg's verbatim answer/source at done, plus explicit wake; (3) route follow-ups by run/delegation id so the host resolves the current owner, preventing stale-session cleanup/misrouting; (4) parent-to-child messages at next turn boundary instead of cancel+respawn, related to TermAl w-b556; reviewers/evaluators stay non-interactive; (5) one explicit finished-worker release with retained result, path-checked worktree cleanup and pending/unknown receipt states; (6) optional typed READY/GO/END/SLOT-FREE plus request→reply links so the host can list unanswered requests. Do NOT copy self-reported completion authority, heartbeats, idle=done, worktree-only sandboxing, runtime reset-all, group wake storms, nested workers or Design Mode as evidence. Native phone app is not the first step. These are mostly TermAl host improvements and must not displace current priorities.
